sqlMap.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT BUYER, PO_NO, STATUS FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND WHERE BUYER IN ( SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'LTAL2') AND IF_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY BUYER, PO_NO, STATUS ORDER BY BUYER, PO_NO, STATUS ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND ROWNUM <= 30

SELECT SEQ AS IF_SEQ , CASE WHEN MAX(A.STATUS) = 'C' THEN 'C' WHEN MAX(A.STATUS) != MIN(A.STATUS) THEN 'U' WHEN MIN(A.STATUS) = 'D' THEN 'D' ELSE MAX(A.STATUS) END AS STATUS , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS IF_DATE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') AS IF_TIME , NVL(MAX(A.LEGACY_PO_NO),' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO , SUM(A.ITEM_AMT) AS TOT_AMT , 'KRW' AS CURRENCY , MAX(A.PO_CREATE_DATE) AS PO_CREATE_DATE , NVL(MAX(TRIM(A.HD_REMARK)),' ') AS HD_REMARK , ' ' AS KEY_1 , ' ' AS KEY_2 , ' ' AS KEY_3 , ' ' AS KEY_4 , ' ' AS KEY_5 FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND A WHERE A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.PO_NO = #PO_NO# AND A.STATUS = #STATUS# AND A.IF_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY A.SEQ, A.BUYER, A.LEGACY_PO_NO, A.PO_CREATE_DATE, A.HD_REMARK, A.STATUS,A.PO_NO

SELECT SEQ AS IF_SEQ ,NVL(TRIM(LEGACY_PO_NO), ' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO ,LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ ,STATUS AS STATUS ,DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION ,BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO ,ITEM_QTY AS ITEM_QTY ,UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE ,F_GET_PER(UNIT_PRICE) AS UNIT_QTY ,UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE ,ITEM_AMT AS ITEM_AMT ,RD_DATE AS RD_DATE ,PLANT AS PLANT ,DELY_TO_LOCATION AS DELY_TO_LOCATION ,LEGACY_USER_ID AS ADD_USER_ID ,NVL(TRIM(PO_NO),' ') AS PO_NO ,NVL(TRIM(KEY_1),' ') AS KEY_1 ,NVL(TRIM(KEY_2),' ') AS KEY_2 ,NVL(TRIM(KEY_3),' ') AS KEY_3 ,NVL(TRIM(KEY_4),' ') AS KEY_4 ,NVL(TRIM(KEY_5),' ') AS KEY_5 ,NVL(TRIM(KEY_6),' ') AS KEY_6 ,NVL(TRIM(KEY_7),' ') AS KEY_7 ,NVL(TRIM(KEY_8),' ') AS KEY_8 ,NVL(TRIM(KEY_9),' ') AS KEY_9 ,NVL(TRIM(KEY_10),' ') AS KEY_10 FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND PO_NO = #PO_NO# AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
sqlMap.update: UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND PO_NO = #PO_NO# AND STATUS = #STATUS# AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
